title: Batanga
ldInstructionsRaw: Moisten the rim of a glass with the cut side of a lime wedge and dip the rim in coarse salt, shaking to remove the excess. Fill the glass with ice, and add the pinch of salt, tequila, and juice of 1/2 a lime. (If your limes are small, use the juice of a whole lime.) Top with chilled cola and briefly stir with the knife used to cut the lime.
